justification: Both show a chunky, frontally posed animal-like being clinging with splayed, digit-incised limbs to a vertical column-like surface, stacked directly above a second, lower figure, with arms bent to clutch at the belly angement rather than an arbitrary pose. The main difference is that A's composition is a fully in-the-round stack in which a large predatory head crouches over an emergent human head and gripping hands, while B places a single high-relief creature above a separate, flat low-relief quadruped shown from above/in a different mode, so the second element is an animal rather than a human.
